issue: GigaChat HTTP 402 loses terminal retry semantics in the LLM gateway

production_symptom.observed_effect: contact intelligence jobs entered retry_wait instead of terminating

root_cause: GigaChatAdapter converted every provider exception to generic provider_error
analyze_text_with_gigachat converted the result to a generic RuntimeError
downstream retry classification therefore defaulted the failure to retryable

verification.command: venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_gigachat_terminal_errors.py tests/test_llm_routing.py tests/test_contact_intelligence.py tests/test_outreach_safety_learning.py

scope_note: The fix stops terminal provider failures from being retried. It does not restore GigaChat billing or alter existing production job rows.
